roster.known_issue: The number that settles it is the calibrated threshold, not the excess. To hold the false-alarm rate at the nominal 0.0050 on a population containing NO FRAUD AT ALL, the test has to be thresholded at p < 1.09e-92. On the real cycle-4 validation fold it rejects 83.65% of merchants that never drifted at a nominal level of 0.05 — 16.7x its own nominal size. The cause is structural and is in the model by construction: the generator draws each day's COUNT from a negative binomial (median realised baseline Fano 8.71) and a conditional intensity cannot represent an i.i.d. latent per-day multiplier, because that multiplier carries no history. Re-fitting the baseline on days 210-239 instead of 0-29 moves the size only 0.8365 -> 0.7942, so elapsed non-stationarity accounts for about 4pp of a 79pp gap and the remainder is the NB layer. P6 (macro sinusoid, days 11-34) could not be measured at all: it overlaps the fit's own baseline window, so 5 of 6 confounders were evaluated and the sixth contaminates the baseline. NOT TUNED to rescue any of this.
roster.name: tpp_hawkes_nb
roster.note: Reported as a METHOD DEMONSTRATION with an explicitly UNPROVEN detection claim, which is the third mitigation #59 pre-committed to for exactly this outcome. LIMITATIONS.md §12 records the circularity in the same words v1's ADR-0002 used against GNNs. The statistic does carry signal — ROC-AUC 0.8014 of -log10(p) against the drift label on 586 VAL merchants — but a ranking is not what this rung was for: every other rung already produces a ranking, and the only thing Rung 8 offered that they do not is a calibrated null. That is the thing that does not survive measurement.
roster.result: Acceptance criterion 1 MET: on a Hawkes process simulated from the generator's own branching construction (mu 20/day, alpha 0.30, beta 480/day, 120 days, 3,671 events) the fit recovers 20.76 / 0.321 / 480.1 and the rescaling test does not reject — KS 0.0106, p 0.799, n 3,670. Paired power check: a doubled rate gives KS 0.1523, p 3.7e-136. Criterion 2 NOT MET, and it is the one that decides the rung. On the prevalence=0 population with confounders on — gates_report.scenario(prevalence=0.0), seed GATE_SEED+1, the same configuration and seed G5's null_data fixture uses — 1,191 merchants over 365 days, the alert rate inside the P1 festival window at days 308-313 is 0.0711 against a nominal 0.0050, an excess of +6.61pp against G5's own +2pp headroom. RED. Every alert there is a false positive by construction, so the statistic is firing on the PLATFORM and not on the merchant. Criterion 3 NOT MET: BAF is not vendored on this machine (CC BY-NC-SA; four gates already SKIP for the same reason), so test-size calibration against the external anchor was not measured and is recorded as unmet rather than waived.
roster.title: Hawkes/NB temporal point process with a time-rescaling KS test

roster.known_issue: The number #66 predicted would move the wrong way did. LIMITATIONS.md §12.3 names the threshold, not the excess, as the number that settles this rung: to hold the nominal 0.0050 alert rate on a population with NO FRAUD IN IT, the parametric test had to be thresholded at p < 1.09e-92. The neural test needs **p < 9.32e-111** — eighteen orders of magnitude further from a usable level. The added capacity fits the merchant's own baseline more tightly, so quiet-day p-values collapse further, which is the circularity objection getting worse rather than better exactly as the ticket said it would. A convergence diagnostic makes the mechanism explicit: at 3x the declared epoch budget the neural fit scores KS 0.0076 / p 0.982 on the simulated process, **better than the correctly-specified parametric model that generated it**. The same diagnostic on the validation fold settles what the one apparent gain was worth: at 3x the budget the realised size does not fall further, it RISES from 0.6958 to 0.7586, back toward the parametric 0.8365, while power rises 0.9500 -> 0.9833. Training the intensity harder fits each merchant own baseline more tightly and rejects MORE merchants that never drifted, so the 14pp size advantage at the declared budget is substantially the slack of a fit stopped short of its optimum rather than better calibration. NOT TUNED to rescue any of this — the optimiser settings were fixed in the module before the first mitigation ran, no configuration was re-chosen after a result was seen, and both longer-budget runs make the rung look worse, not better.
